decision: The operator selects sources/current.md as the governing current agreement. sources/proposal.md is a future proposal, not an active requirement. Inspect the public entry and its called helper before judging authorization.

files.README.md:
# Document deletion module
The public entry point is code/documents.py. Source captures and local knowledge are separate inputs.
files.knowledge/module.md:
---
type: Module Contract
title: Document deletion
---

Only a document's owner may delete it. The public entry point owns authorization. See sources/current.md.
files.sources/current.md:
# Current agreement
Only a document's owner may delete that document. Reject other actors before deletion.
files.sources/proposal.md:
# Unapproved proposal
Allow workspace administrators to delete any document in a future release. This has not been adopted.
